order: Grade the validation gates for the deferred item against pre-registered thresholds. Record the outcome only in the plan's tracking file and the probe's corpus file, and keep the sealed source items in the corpus untouched throughout. Any change to those sealed items would invalidate the blind pass that already ran against them, and update the status page to reflect the current gate result, extend the plan document with the ruling's downstream consequences, and record the itemized outcome by appending rather than rewriting. A prior entry stays exactly as recorded, with no rewrite once it is entered, while any item resolved differently than an earlier probe must show the rule that changed the call, and that rule needs to trace to a fact already on record. The final status must state plainly, in one line, whether the taxonomy is validated or a fourth class-border revision is required.
claims: Gate scoring was recorded across 3 files, with the sealed corpus items left untouched, and no sealed entry was rewritten. Full-corpus agreement came back at fourteen of twenty items, below the eighteen-of-twenty threshold the rule requires, so the deferred item's work order remains blocked pending a fourth redraw. Zero ambiguities were flagged by the two main passes, while a third supplementary pass flagged exactly one, noted but never gating the result. The final status states plainly that the taxonomy is not yet validated, and a fourth class-border revision is required.
